text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Blend contamination is the most common flag in the trigger: 639 of 978 points (about 65%) are flagged as blend_suspect, so the photometry at many epochs may reflect neighbouring-star light rather than this star alone.","evidence_ids":["E-058"]},{"text":"Several of the listed event points carry blend or shape-outlier tags, including E-042, E-043, E-044, E-046, E-048, E-052 and E-054, so some of the apparent dips and rises could come from crowding or mis-shaped images rather than real brightness change.","evidence_ids":["E-042","E-043","E-044","E-046","E-048","E-052","E-054"]},{"text":"Shape outliers are widespread (283 of 978 flagged), and the listed points E-041, E-043, E-044 and E-054 carry SHAPE_OUTLIER, which is consistent with plate-image or measurement defects instead of stellar variability.","evidence_ids":["E-060","E-041","E-043","E-044","E-054"]},{"text":"Emulsion problems are present: 58 points are flagged emulsion_non_blue and 2 emulsion_unknown, so colour and emulsion response differences between plate series could produce offsets that look like a long-term change.","evidence_ids":["E-056","E-057"]},{"text":"The event spans series with very different zero points (for example ma at 0.907, i at 0.822, rh at -0.195, bm at -0.299, dnb at -0.322), and the event points move between these series, so a seam between plate series could mimic a step in the lightcurve; plate-edge flags on E-053 and 42 plate-edge points add to this concern.","evidence_ids":["E-031","E-028","E-038","E-021","E-024","E-053","E-061","E-002"]}]}
